lines: +# Lines of a sanitizer report in the stderr of a ClickHouse process, as a `grep` basic regular expression. AddressSanitizer and ThreadSanitizer open a report with a line of `=`, but MemorySanitizer (`==PID==WARNING: MemorySanitizer: ...`) and UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer (`file:line:column: runtime error: ...`, then `SUMMARY: UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer: ...`) do not, so the report lines themselves are matched too. The sanitizer name alone is not enough: AddressSanitizer may print `==PID==AddressSanitizer: failed to intercept ...` at startup.
+# For `docker.log`, which also has the output of other services: Go programs such as MinIO print `panic: runtime error: ...`, so only the lines that name a sanitizer count there.
